propositions: Standing eval completion-verifier constructs one PydanticAIRunner before entering per-case disposable repositories, so LLMConfig.repo_path remains bound to the eval checkout root instead of each case fixture
Runner._effective_config substitutes only request model/limit tuning and preserves the base repo_path, causing filesystem and ticket tools to read from checkout instead of case fixture
Agentic eval cases that require fixture files (targeted COMPLETE cases) fail when the runner reads the wrong checkout root, while operator-attested cases pass because they need no fixture code

Fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner at each disposable case store via _rerooted() and clears tickets_path so ticket tools read the fixture's own seeded store, scoped to the eval path without affecting production gate config
